fruits.extendedStory: It was begun around 1100 and went on being built for centuries, Gothic, thirty metres tall. It stands on high ground in the old city. That is why you reach it up a broad flight of steps rather than along a street. The climb is part of the building. From the top you look back over the roofs you have just walked under.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Begonnen wurde sie um 1100 und über Jahrhunderte weitergebaut, gotisch, 30 Meter hoch. Sie steht auf der Höhe der alten Stadt. Darum führt zu ihr eine Freitreppe hinauf statt eines Weges. Der Aufstieg gehört zum Bau. Von oben schaut man auf die Dächer zurück, über die man eben noch gelaufen ist.
localizedExtendedStory.en: It was begun around 1100 and went on being built for centuries, Gothic, thirty metres tall. It stands on high ground in the old city. That is why you reach it up a broad flight of steps rather than along a street. The climb is part of the building. From the top you look back over the roofs you have just walked under.

localizedStory.de: Die Kathedrale wuchs ab 1100 den Hügel hinauf. Wer sie erreichen will, nimmt die Treppe.
localizedStory.en: The cathedral climbed this hill from 1100 onward. To reach it you take the stairs.

fruits.name: Catedral de Girona
fruits.story: The cathedral climbed this hill from 1100 onward. To reach it you take the stairs.

fruits.extendedStory: This was Girona's cathedral until the 10th century. Eight sarcophagi are set into its walls, pagan and early Christian, cut in the 4th century. They were already ancient when they were built in. The slender bell tower was added between the 14th and 16th centuries. Inside lies a Recumbent Christ that Aloi de Montbrai carved from stone in the 14th century.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Das war Gironas Kathedrale, bis ins 10. Jahrhundert. Acht Sarkophage stecken in den Wänden, heidnische und frühchristliche, aus dem 4. Jahrhundert. Sie waren schon alt, als man sie einmauerte. Der schlanke Glockenturm kam zwischen dem 14. und 16. Jahrhundert dazu. Drinnen liegt ein Christus, den Aloi de Montbrai im 14. Jahrhundert aus Stein schnitt.
localizedExtendedStory.en: This was Girona's cathedral until the 10th century. Eight sarcophagi are set into its walls, pagan and early Christian, cut in the 4th century. They were already ancient when they were built in. The slender bell tower was added between the 14th and 16th centuries. Inside lies a Recumbent Christ that Aloi de Montbrai carved from stone in the 14th century.

localizedStory.de: Acht Sarkophage aus dem 4. Jahrhundert stecken in den Wänden. Sie sind älter als die Kirche um sie herum.
localizedStory.en: Eight sarcophagi of the 4th century are set into the walls. They are older than the church around them.

fruits.name: Basilica de Sant Feliu
fruits.story: Eight sarcophagi of the 4th century are set into the walls. They are older than the church around them.

fruits.extendedStory: The monks came in the 12th century and built in the Romanesque way, heavy and plain. The best of it is the capitals, the carved stone tops of the columns in the nave and the cloister. They are cut like the pages of a book, and people still come to read them. The Museum of Archaeology of Catalonia has since moved into the monastery.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Mönche kamen im 12. Jahrhundert und bauten romanisch, schwer und schlicht. Das Beste sind die Kapitelle, die Steinköpfe oben auf den Säulen im Mittelschiff und im Kreuzgang. Sie sind geschnitzt wie Seiten eines Buches, und Besucher lesen sie noch heute ab. Im Kloster wohnt inzwischen das Archäologische Museum Kataloniens.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The monks came in the 12th century and built in the Romanesque way, heavy and plain. The best of it is the capitals, the carved stone tops of the columns in the nave and the cloister. They are cut like the pages of a book, and people still come to read them. The Museum of Archaeology of Catalonia has since moved into the monastery.

localizedStory.de: Ein Benediktinerkloster aus dem 12. Jahrhundert. Heute liegt Kataloniens Archäologie darin.
localizedStory.en: A Benedictine monastery of the 12th century. Catalonia's archaeology lives inside it now.

fruits.name: Església de Sant Pere de Galligants
fruits.story: A Benedictine monastery of the 12th century. Catalonia's archaeology lives inside it now.

fruits.extendedStory: The name misleads. It was built in the 12th century in the Romanesque manner, modelled on Roman baths rather than Arab ones. You came in through the entrance under the barrel vault, undressed there and rested. The surprise is behind it. Over the central pool a dome stands on slim columns, and every capital holding it up is carved differently from its neighbours.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Name führt in die Irre. Gebaut wurde es im 12. Jahrhundert in romanischer Bauweise, nach dem Vorbild römischer Bäder. Durch den Eingang unter dem Tonnengewölbe kam man herein, zog sich aus und ruhte. Dahinter steht die eigentliche Überraschung. Über dem Becken in der Mitte trägt eine Kuppel auf dünnen Säulen, und jedes Kapitell darauf ist einzeln geschnitzt.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The name misleads. It was built in the 12th century in the Romanesque manner, modelled on Roman baths rather than Arab ones. You came in through the entrance under the barrel vault, undressed there and rested. The surprise is behind it. Over the central pool a dome stands on slim columns, and every capital holding it up is carved differently from its neighbours.

localizedStory.de: Sie heißen Arabische Bäder und sind es nicht. Das Haus ist romanisch, aus dem 12. Jahrhundert.
localizedStory.en: They are called the Arab Baths and they are not. The building is Romanesque, of the 12th century.

fruits.name: Banys Àrabs
fruits.story: They are called the Arab Baths and they are not. The building is Romanesque, of the 12th century.

fruits.extendedStory: The Call is one of the best preserved Jewish quarters in the world. It sits inside the Forca Vella, the walled core of Girona. It is a tangle of narrow lanes and courtyards that have kept their medieval air to this day. The lanes turn without warning. Then you are standing in a quiet courtyard you could not see from the street.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Das Call ist eines der besterhaltenen jüdischen Viertel der Welt. Es liegt in der Forca Vella, dem ummauerten Kern Gironas. Ein Gewirr aus engen Gassen und Innenhöfen, das seine mittelalterliche Luft behalten hat. Die Gassen knicken ohne Vorwarnung ab. Dann steht man in einem stillen Hof, den man von der Straße aus nicht gesehen hat.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The Call is one of the best preserved Jewish quarters in the world. It sits inside the Forca Vella, the walled core of Girona. It is a tangle of narrow lanes and courtyards that have kept their medieval air to this day. The lanes turn without warning. Then you are standing in a quiet courtyard you could not see from the street.

localizedStory.de: Rund um dieses Museum liegt das Call, eines der besterhaltenen jüdischen Viertel der Welt.
localizedStory.en: Around this museum lies the Call, one of the best preserved Jewish quarters in the world.

fruits.name: Museu d'Història dels Jueus
fruits.story: Around this museum lies the Call, one of the best preserved Jewish quarters in the world.

fruits.extendedStory: The Eiffel company of Paris won the contract in January 1877 and had finished by July. Their bid was 22,500 pessetes. Girona still calls it the Palanques Vermelles, the red footbridges. Stand in the middle and look downriver. The old town appears framed between the red struts, which is why half the city's photographs are taken from this spot.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Pariser Firma Eiffel gewann den Auftrag im Januar 1877 und war im Juli schon fertig. Geboten hatte sie 22.500 Peseten. Girona nennt die Brücke bis heute Palanques Vermelles, die roten Stege. Stell dich in die Mitte und schau flussabwärts. Zwischen den roten Streben liegt die Altstadt gerahmt wie ein Bild.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The Eiffel company of Paris won the contract in January 1877 and had finished by July. Their bid was 22,500 pessetes. Girona still calls it the Palanques Vermelles, the red footbridges. Stand in the middle and look downriver. The old town appears framed between the red struts, which is why half the city's photographs are taken from this spot.

localizedStory.de: Die rote Eisenbrücke baute 1877 dieselbe Firma, die später den Eiffelturm errichtete.
localizedStory.en: The red iron bridge was built in 1877 by the same company that later raised the Eiffel Tower.

fruits.name: Pont de les Peixateries Velles
fruits.story: The red iron bridge was built in 1877 by the same company that later raised the Eiffel Tower.

fruits.extendedStory: The engineer Constanti German drew it in 1849, but it did not open until 29 June 1856. Before it stood a stone bridge of the 14th century called the Sant Francesc. Look at the piers from the side. Each carries a pointed nose facing upstream, so that the Onyar in flood breaks on that edge instead of on the bridge.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Ingenieur Constanti German zeichnete sie 1849. Eröffnet wurde sie erst am 29. Juni 1856. Vor ihr stand hier eine Steinbrücke aus dem 14. Jahrhundert, die Sant Francesc hieß. Schau von der Seite auf die Pfeiler. Jeder trägt eine spitze Nase gegen die Strömung, damit das Hochwasser des Onyar sich an ihr bricht statt an der Brücke.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The engineer Constanti German drew it in 1849, but it did not open until 29 June 1856. Before it stood a stone bridge of the 14th century called the Sant Francesc. Look at the piers from the side. Each carries a pointed nose facing upstream, so that the Onyar in flood breaks on that edge instead of on the bridge.

localizedStory.de: Drei flache Bögen auf zwei Pfeilern. Die Steinbrücke wurde 1856 eröffnet, an der Stelle einer aus dem 14. Jahrhundert.
localizedStory.en: Three flattened arches on two piers. The stone bridge opened in 1856, in place of a 14th-century one.

fruits.name: Pont de Pedra
fruits.story: Three flattened arches on two piers. The stone bridge opened in 1856, in place of a 14th-century one.

fruits.extendedStory: Look down from this tower onto the convent of Sant Domènec. It gave the tower its name. It was also one of the first Gothic buildings in Catalonia, raised across the 13th and 14th centuries. Pick out its church, its chapterhouse and its great cloister. None of it stands empty: the university keeps its humanities faculty inside, so on a weekday it is full of students.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Schau vom Turm hinunter auf das Kloster Sant Domènec. Es gab dem Turm seinen Namen und war eines der ersten gotischen Gebäude Kataloniens, gebaut im 13. und 14. Jahrhundert. Achte auf die Kirche, den Kapitelsaal und den großen Kreuzgang. Leer steht davon nichts: Die Universität hat ihre Geisteswissenschaften darin, unter der Woche ist alles voller Studenten. Der Mauerweg selbst folgt den längsten karolingischen Mauern Europas, aufgeworfen im 9. Jahrhundert.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Look down from this tower onto the convent of Sant Domènec. It gave the tower its name. It was also one of the first Gothic buildings in Catalonia, raised across the 13th and 14th centuries. Pick out its church, its chapterhouse and its great cloister. None of it stands empty: the university keeps its humanities faculty inside, so on a weekday it is full of students.

localizedStory.de: Ein Turm auf dem Mauerweg. Von hier schaust du hinunter auf das Kloster, das ihm seinen Namen gab.
localizedStory.en: A tower on the wall walk. From up here you look down on the convent that gave it its name.

fruits.name: Torre de Sant Domenec
fruits.story: A tower on the wall walk. From up here you look down on the convent that gave it its name.
